sentences.en: Juha saw an old man planting a tree.
The old man was ninety years old.
He dug very slowly in the earth.
Juha stood and looked at him.
He asked: what tree is this?
The old man said: a nut tree.

sentences.ar: ג'וחא שאל: ומתי הוא נותן פרי?
sentences.en: Juha asked: and when does it give fruit?
The old man said: after twenty years.
Juha laughed and said quietly: forgive me.

sentences.ar: הוא אמר: אתה לא תאכל ממנו.
sentences.en: He said: you will not eat from it.

sentences.ar: הזקן המשיך לחפור ולא הרים ראש.
sentences.en: The old man went on digging and did not raise his head.

sentences.ar: הוא אמר: גם אני לא שתלתי.
sentences.en: He said: I did not plant either.
He said: and I ate all my life.
He said: someone planted for me.
Juha took a stick and began to dig.
They planted together until the evening.
